'''September 2000 Menomonee Falls tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Menomonee Falls, Wisconsin in September 2000. [[Bryan Prittie]] won it. It is known from Bryan Prittie's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1208">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-09-big-floppy-donkey-d-ck-men-falls-wid1208/ big-floppy-donkey-d-ck-men-falls-wi], DeckTech (Bryan "DMX" Prittie, 9 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-09-big-floppy-donkey-d-ck-men-falls-wid1208/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' September 2000
* '''Site:''' Menomonee Falls, Wisconsin
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Bryan Prittie]]
